response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS average_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(average_rate_per_day) AS overall_benchmark FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.average_rate_per_day, ra.film_count, ra.average_rate_per_day / b.overall_benchmark AS average_to_benchmark FROM rating_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.overall_benchmark IS NOT NULL
